title: Nurse training schools in the United States, 1880–1920 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the number of nurse training schools in the United States. 1880, 15; 1884–85, 34; 1889–90, 35; 1894–95, 131; 1899–1900, 432; 1904–05, 862; 1909–10, 1,129; 1914–15, 1,509; 1919–20, 1,755. Data: US Bureau of Education, Statistics of Nurse Training Schools, 1919–1920, Bulletin 1921 no. 51, table 1.
heading: TRAINING SCHOOLS · LOG SCALE
